question: What is the real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth for the year 2025–26 projected by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.5%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, in its **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)** meeting held in **February 2025**, projected the **Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** growth for the financial year **2025-26** at **6.5%**.
 
• The quarterly growth projections for **FY 2025-26** are distributed as follows: **Q1 at 6.7%**, **Q2 at 6.5%**, **Q3 at 6.4%**, and **Q4 at 6.5%**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the 6.5% projection is correct.***
 
• The **MPC**, led by **Governor Shaktikanta Das**, noted that the growth trajectory is supported by a sustained momentum in **investment activity** and a recovery in **rural consumption**.
